That is the exact follow-up gap the brief was written to close. closeout.md:3 says these writes are "held until the fast-write fix lands", but the brief asks for them to be written now with the item tool. Start each one with `{"tasks":{"<id>":{"start":{},"path":…,"agent":…}}}`, or queue it.

closeout.md has no closing `show:` line with the counts before and after (brief, Do 2). Compute the counts from the record with a script; don't type them by hand. Today the record holds 209 tasks: complete 101, stopped 78, waiting 21, idle 8, running 1.

`handled()` in Server/PromptRecords.mjs (diff line 33) checks the state on the task's `add` line only, not its current state. Now that every task starts `idle`, it will also complete a task a tab has already started (running), or one that is already complete, as "routed to …". That breaks the doc's own rule: "the ask is not complete until the work is" (prompt-tasks.md, One writer, step 2). The simpler fix is to reuse the new `tasks()` fold and complete only the tasks it reports as idle or waiting.
`tasks()` (diff lines 43–52) folds only `tasks.{id}.{verb}` lines. It ignores `{"decide":…}` lines, so an older proposal that was approved or rejected keeps showing its stale `waiting` state.

Ask 3, second bullet (check-in prompts are never split): the diff doesn't touch it. The existing `turnOrigin` filter already covers it (prompt-tasks.md step 2), but closeout.md doesn't name that as the evidence.

Ask 3, third bullet (the tab attaches to the splitter's task) rests on a rule in Servex/agents/roles/vscode-mastermind.md:20. That change is uncommitted and not in this diff, and it doesn't point to the `PromptRecords --tasks` command. Commit it with this diff and link the command, or a tab will keep filing its own task for each ask.

The splitter change needs a Servex restart before it does anything (prompt-tasks.md, Watch out). Until then, new asks are still filed waiting on the owner, so the task isn't done until the restart has happened and has been checked.
